build_knn_cuda_heap: build a CUDA-based KNN query using a heap data structure to find k-nearest points in 3D space
create_knn_forward_call: create a forward pass that finds k-nearest neighbor indices for point cloud features with shape B N 3
test_KNN_class: test the KNN autograd Function class by calling KNN.apply with k, xyz tensor, and optional center_xyz tensor
refactor_knn_transposed_input: refactor the knn call to accept transposed tensors with shape B 3 N instead of B N 3
summarize_knn_module: summarize the knn module that loads a CUDA extension and exposes KNN.apply for finding nearest neighbors
